title: Watched Pot
joke: Someone stares at a coin sprout with a magnifying glass, while the sign says compounding works best when ignored.
caption:
That magnifying glass is doing nothing for the coin.
Growth from time is slow and boring to watch, which is exactly why constant checking makes people quit early.
How often do you check your savings?
